name: porch birdhouse
caption: A porch birdhouse with a main chamber, a small porch and a sloped roof. Four walls form a chamber; a square entrance sits in the front. Flat wall panels keep an even thickness with a stepped roof line. Overall width is 1.30 times depth; height is 0.80 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous blue-gray, cream, charcoal color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
